owner_direction: Keep KEP as the protocol acronym and expand it as Knowledge Expansion Protocol.
Give the product built on KEP a separate CyberAlchemy product name.
Use CyberAlchemy Exchange as the selected working product name.

definitions.formal_candidate: CyberAlchemy Exchange is the CyberAlchemy product through which participants prepare, perform, and inspect governed knowledge-expansion interactions implemented using KEP. The product name identifies the participant-facing application and experience; it does not rename the protocol, settlement network, or any protocol-defined state.
definitions.plain_language: CyberAlchemy Exchange is the product people enter and use.
definitions.domain_context: In the current hosted Devnet vertical, CyberAlchemy Exchange contains the explanatory landing surface, white-paper view, and guided six-scene KEP workbench.
definitions.boundary: The name does not establish marketplace liquidity, a knowledge price, legal ownership, licensing rights, production readiness, publication approval, or deployment authority.

definitions.formal_candidate: Knowledge Expansion Protocol is the technical protocol used by CyberAlchemy Exchange to represent an authorized, non-exclusive expansion of recognized membership and recipient-bound encrypted access for one exact Knowledge Artifact Version while preserving existing recognized members.
definitions.plain_language: KEP lets knowledge reach another authorized identity without removing the originator.
definitions.domain_context: The first KEP vertical models owners(V) changing from {A} to {A, B}, with encrypted material held off-chain and bounded public coordination on Solana Devnet.
definitions.boundary: KEP is not the product brand, Solana itself, a sale, an exclusive transfer, copyright title, a license, a guarantee of decryptable delivery, or proof of production security.

usage_rules: Use CyberAlchemy Exchange for the participant-facing product and application.
Use Knowledge Expansion Protocol or KEP for the technical protocol.
Use Powered by KEP when connecting the product brand to the protocol.
Do not use CyberAlchemy Exchange and KEP as interchangeable names.
Do not imply that the candidate name changes any active protocol semantic, admitted ontology, DomainSpec source, implementation binding, or authority decision.
claim_ceiling: This record is a reviewable naming candidate and a bounded source for narrative interface copy. It does not promote a canonical definition, alter an admitted predecessor, prove implementation conformance, authorize publication or deployment, or establish trademark clearance.
